answer: Each identity secures 1,000 unique credential nullifiers anchored to a deep lagoon registry to prevent sybil expansion. An honest participant pays 1x the cost of credential signing, while 1,000 fakes must solve 1,000x the load to clear a crystal threshold. A verifier checks the ocean of keys for collisions; if evidence of duplicate identities appears, the system enforces a slash. This assumes credentials are not shareable.
